run_inverse_kinematics_pole_simulation: run the pybullet inverse kinematics pole simulation that moves an end effector along a circular path
calculate_inverse_kinematics: calculate inverse kinematics for a URDF robot using pybullet calculateInverseKinematics with joint damping and solver options
reset_joint_state: reset joint state on a pybullet robot body using resetJointState to apply computed IK positions
load_urdf_and_configure_simulation: load a URDF robot model into pybullet and configure gravity, real-time simulation, and rendering
visualize_end_effector_trails: visualize target and actual end effector position trails using addUserDebugLine in pybullet
